question: According to Census of India 2011, which state recorded negative population growth rate?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nagaland**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Nagaland** recorded a negative population growth rate according to the Census of India 2011.
 
• This decrease in population could be attributed to various factors including migration, lower birth rates, and higher mortality rates.
 
• Nagaland is the only state in India to have shown a decline in its population growth during this period.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Census of India** is conducted every ten years and is the most comprehensive source of demographic data in the country.
 
• The 2011 Census was the 15th National Census of the country since 1872 and the 7th Census after independence.
 
• The Census provides critical data on population size, distribution, socio-economic and cultural characteristics, among others.
 
• The data collected from the Census is used for policy-making, planning, and administration by the government.
 
• Population growth rate is a crucial indicator of the demographic trends and development of a region.
